newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 1.9 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 1.9 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 61,026 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended February 22, up 1.9 percent from the same period in 1996, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Wednesday.
The amount of weekly power supplied to the Rocky Mountain area showed the largest rise, up 5.3 percent to 2,910 GWh, EEI said.
The New England region experienced the largest decrease in power output, falling 6.4 percent from the corresponding period a year earlier to 2,188 GWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production ended February 22 totaled 517,758 GWh, a rise of 0.2 percent from the same period in 1996, EEI said.
